plan.title: Convert to Auction available during RFQ evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ in evaluation; prepared-state cases must start from the summary screen.
Enable the eRFX project capability required by the case.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Assert that Convert to Auction is offered and clickable for this RFQ state.
Select Convert to Auction to open its confirmation window without completing the conversion.
Assert that the conversion confirmation window opened and exposes Cancel.
Cancel the conversion so the RFQ remains unchanged.
Confirm the cancellation left the page without an application error.
